title: UAAP: NU, UP claim inaugural overall crowns in badminton

blocks.text: National University and the University of the Philippines captured the UAAP Season 89 overall championships in men's and women's badminton, respectively, after the conclusion of the tournament on Tuesday at the Gameville Central Park in Mandaluyong City.
